clues.hint: Old Testament prophet; a book is named after him

clues.clue: My brother tried to curse Israel but kept blessing them instead.
clues.hint: Talking donkey; book of Numbers; king of Moab

clues.clue: The shortest verse in the King James Bible: "Jesus wept."
clues.hint: Gospel of John

clues.clue: Paul's missionary companion who deserted him in Pamphylia, according to Acts.
clues.hint: Also a Gospel author

clues.clue: The Old Testament book that never mentions God by name, yet tells of Esther and Mordecai.
clues.hint: Purim

clues.clue: Spell Paul's signature greeting in all his letters: "_____ and peace from God our Father..."
clues.answer: What is G-R-A-C-E? (Grace — the missing word)
clues.hint: 5 letters; Paul opens every epistle with it

clues.clue: Spell the mountaintop experience that James, Peter, and John witnessed with Jesus.
clues.hint: 14 letters; Moses and Elijah appeared

clues.clue: Hebrews describes Jesus as the Great High Priest in the order of _____, king of _____. Spell both blanks.
clues.hint: Mysterious king from Genesis 14; his city later became Jerusalem

clues.clue: Spell the two sides of the free will and God's sovereignty debate whose theology is based on flower acronyms.
clues.hint: One uses TULIP, the other ROSES (or ACURA); both named after theologians

clues.clue: Play Snake: collect 10 apples without crashing!
clues.hint: Arrow keys or W A S D

clues.clue: Play Flappy Bird: fly through 15 poles without crashing!
clues.hint: Space bar, up arrow or click to flap

clues.clue: Play the typing test: type 40 words at 80 WPM or faster!
clues.hint: The clock starts on your first key

clues.clue: Play Tetris: clear 5 lines before the stack reaches the top!
clues.hint: Arrow keys to move and rotate, space to drop

clues.clue: Play the reaction test: only press when the screen flashes PINK!
clues.answer: What is reacting in under 350 ms?
clues.hint: Green or any other colour is a fail. You get 3 tries.

clues.clue: What is $(76 \times 67 - 67 \times 76) + 67^2$?
clues.hint: The two products cancel

clues.clue: A sack holds 3 red balls and 2 blue balls. You draw two balls at random without replacement. What is the probability that both balls drawn are red?
clues.hint: Without replacement: multiply sequential probabilities (first draw 3/5, then 2/4).

clues.clue: In combinatorics, an ordering of distinct objects is called a ___.
clues.hint: $n$Pr — arrangements without repetition

clues.clue: How many **squares** and how many **triangles** appear in the figure? (Each triangle side must lie entirely along a drawn line segment.)
clues.hint: Squares: four $1\times1$, the outer $2\times2$, and the center diamond. Triangles: count by area — $16$ of size $\frac14$, $12$ of size $\frac12$, and $8$ of size $1$ (using the grid center). Accept ±5 on each count (squares 5–15, triangles 39–49).

clues.clue: Oh, so you like math? Name every standard Calc 2 integration technique—and while you're at it, find $$\int x^2 e^x \, dx.$$
clues.answer: What are u-substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions, trigonometric substitution, trigonometric integrals, and improper integrals—and what is $e^x(x^2 - 2x + 2) + C$?
clues.hint: LIATE: pick $u = x^2$; you'll need integration by parts twice

clues.clue: Romans 3:23 — Finish the verse: "For all have sinned, and come short of…"
clues.hint: KJV; Paul’s letter to Rome — "all have sinned"

clues.clue: 2 Corinthians 5:17 — Finish the verse: "Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are…"
clues.hint: KJV; Paul’s letter to Corinth — new creation in Christ

clues.clue: Give me a verse that you've used to cope with suffering.
clues.answer: Host judgment: accept any appropriate Scripture the player shares and can briefly explain. Examples: Romans 8:28; 2 Corinthians 1:3–4; Psalm 23; 1 Peter 5:7; James 1:2–4; Isaiah 41:10.
clues.hint: Subjective — reward sincere, relevant verses; no single "right" reference required

clues.clue: Jeremiah 29:11 — Finish the verse: "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an…"
clues.hint: KJV; letter to exiles in Babylon — often quoted for hope in hard seasons

clues.clue: List 7 verses from NavTMS (max 3 verses per person).
clues.answer: Team activity: the team must name 7 distinct NavTMS verses total; no player may contribute more than 3. Host verifies each reference is on the NavTMS list and counts unique verses across the team. Award points when all 7 are valid; partial credit at host discretion.
clues.hint: NavTMS — your group’s verse memory set; ask the host if you need the list
